properties.displayName: QC - (Cross Workspace) ThreatIntel IP to SigninLogs
properties.description:
Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence is a platform that conducts threat infrastructure analysis and gathers threat intelligence.
This analytic identifies a match in SigninLogs on any IP Indicator of Compromise (IOC) from TI.
properties.query:
let queryFrequency = 1h;
let queryPeriod = 14d;
let qcMfaModChecks = qcMfaModificationChecks(); //call the workspace function
let mfaModTargetUserIds =
qcMfaModChecks
| distinct tostring(TargetId);
let AADFunction = (tableName:string){
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(queryPeriod)
    | where ExpirationDateTime > now()
    | summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
    | where Active == true
    // Pick up IOC alerts that contain entities of interest.
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
        or isnotempty(EmailSourceIpAddress)
        or isnotempty(NetworkDestinationIP)
        or isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP)
    // Taking the first non-empty value (NetworkIP first) based on potential IOC match availability.
    | extend IpAddr = iff(isnotempty(NetworkIP), NetworkIP, NetworkDestinationIP)
    | extend IpAddr = iff(isempty(IpAddr) and isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP), NetworkSourceIP, IpAddr)
    | extend IpAddr = iff(isempty(IpAddr) and isnotempty(EmailSourceIpAddress), EmailSourceIpAddress, IpAddr)
    // Using innerunique join flavor to improve performance and only need one match.
    | join kind=innerunique (
        table(tableName)
        | where TimeGenerated >= ago(queryFrequency)
        | extend Status = parse_json(Status)
        | evaluate bag_unpack(Status)
        | extend ErrorCode = column_ifexists("errorCode", "")
        | extend AdditionalDetails = column_ifexists("additionalDetails", "")
        | extend FailureReason = column_ifexists("failureReason", "")
        | where UserId !in (mfaModTargetUserIds) //exclude accounts with recent mfa changes
        | where AdditionalDetails !in~ (
            "MFA not required during Windows broker logon flow" // MFA not required as IP already seen.
            "MFA completed in Azure AD" // User completed MFA in AAD.
        )
        // Remove AAD joined/registered devices.
        | extend Device = parse_json(DeviceDetail)
        | evaluate bag_unpack(Device, columnsConflict="replace_source")
        | extend TrustType = column_ifexists("trustType", "")
        | where TrustType !in~ (
        "Hybrid Azure AD joined",
        "Azure AD registered",
        "Azure AD joined"
        )
        // Filter out unsuccessful signins from TI feed.
        | where ErrorCode in (
            0,
            50125,
            50140,
            530002
        )
        | extend Location = parse_json(LocationDetails)
        | evaluate bag_unpack(Location)
        | extend State = column_ifexists("state", "")
        | extend City = column_ifexists("city", "")
        | extend Region = column_ifexists("countryOrRegion", "")
        | extend Location = strcat(City, ", ", State, " ", Region)
        | extend IpAddr = IPAddress
        // Renaming time column so log source clear.
        | extend SignInTimeGenerated = TimeGenerated
    ) on IpAddr
    | where SignInTimeGenerated < ExpirationDateTime
    | summarize SignInTimeGenerated = arg_max(SignInTimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId, IpAddr
    | where ConfidenceScore >= 90
| project
    SignInTimeGenerated,
    Description,
    ActivityGroupNames,
    IndicatorId,
    ThreatType,
    Url,
    ExpirationDateTime,
    ConfidenceScore,
    IpAddr,
    UserName = Identity,
    UserPrincipalName,
    UserId,
    UserAgent = UserAgent1,
    AppDisplayName,
    AppId,
    Location,
    ErrorCode,
    AdditionalDetails,
    FailureReason,
    NetworkIP,
    NetworkDestinationIP,
    NetworkSourceIP,
    EmailSourceIpAddress,
    Type
};
let AADSignInLogs = AADFunction("xw_signinlogs");
let AADNonIntSignInLogs = AADFunction("xw_aadnoninteractiveusersigninlogs");
union isfuzzy=true AADSignInLogs, AADNonIntSignInLogs
